parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is a wheel of the cart made of rubber, typically circular and attached to the base frame.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the cart to roll smoothly and supports the load during movement.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle to enable forward and backward motion.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is another wheel of the cart, identical to the first one, made of rubber and attached to the opposite side of the base.
parts.Functional_description: It provides balance and stability, working together with the other wheel to support motion.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle, synchronized with the other wheel for smooth rolling.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body or frame of the cart, made of steel, providing structural support and load-bearing capacity.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the carried items and connects all other parts, including the wheels and handles.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to the wheels, serving as the rigid frame of the cart.
